summary: Toronto-Dominion Bank filed a Form 6-K furnishing US counsel and Canadian counsel legal opinions, consents and related exhibits tied to an already-priced senior medium-term note issuance under its existing Form F-3 shelf. The bank is issuing US$1.0bn 5.198% Series F notes due 2028, US$400mn floating-rate 2028 notes, US$1.1bn 5.473% notes due 2031 and US$1.25bn 5.801% notes due 2036, totaling US$3.75bn. No merger, tender, activist, spin-off, restructuring or capital-return event is disclosed; this is a routine debt shelf takedown, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
